g.text: C038 — Experimental coupler characterization and data fitting (Sec 4.1.3, Fig 4.10)

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Sweep fabricated lengths, fit sin²/cos² vs L + z_bend: Lx = 16.2—16.8 um, z_bend = 2.3—2.8 um.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Method: spectra 1500—1570 nm, grating coupler centred at 1550 nm via fibre angle; traces integrated + normalized.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: sweeping the fabricated length series and fitting sin²/cos² vs L + z_bend extracts Lx and the bend contribution, matching the mode calculation.
